35 of the Best Gifts for College Students—Cozy Splurges and Smart Solutions Make the Cut

Freshman or grad student, they'll love these thoughtful picks.

By Alyssa LongobuccoPublished: Sep 18, 2025 3:51 PM EDT
SAVE ARTICLE
SHARE ARTICLE

Our editors handpick the products that we feature. We may earn commission from the links on this page.

College marks a major turning point in a young person's life. For many, it's their first time away from home—in a new environment where they're not only responsible for learning and growing but also surviving without help from a parent or guardian nearby. If they're still living at home, the academic and social challenges pack plenty of opportunities for growth (and stress!). Needless to say, freshmen eager (and nervous) to make their mark could definitely use a bit of extra love. But so can any college student who is juggling a busy social life with rigorous academics. The best news? There are plenty of ways to show your support, whether that's writing an old-fashioned piece of snail mail, planning a weekend visit, or sending a thoughtful gift geared toward making collegiate life more comfortable.

The best gifts for college students live at the intersection of practicality and purpose. Living in a dorm, off-campus apartment, or Greek house is often tight when it comes to space, so skip anything bulky or unnecessary; they'll struggle to stuff beneath their lofted bed. If they're bunking at home, they'll probably need less in the way of organizational gadgets and small-scale appliances, too. Instead, think about what truly makes daily life easier for the specific college kid on your list—and consider something special they wouldn't splurge on themselves.

Below, you'll find 35 of our favorite gifts for college students, each chosen to upgrade their collegiate experience, including one of Oprah's Favorite Things and the cutest stadium-friendly bag from the 2025 Back to School O List. Think: a way to make their beloved morning latte right in their room, a plush robe that will keep them cozy during the walk to the showers, or a weekender bag that may even tempt them to come home once in a while.

1
VIBE CHECK
Orren Ellis Writzer Rechargeable LED Mushroom Table Lamp
$70
WAYFAIR
CREDIT: WAYFAIR

Let's face it: Dorm rooms are not always the most well-designed spaces, and creature comforts like ambient lighting can be in short supply. This rechargeable LED lamp will help illuminate their desk or nightstand and really up the vibe in the process.

2
THE O LIST
Mark and Graham Essential Leather Zipper Crossbody
$5,000
MARK AND GRAHAM
CREDIT: MARK AND GRAHAM

A clear, stadium-friendly bag they'll actually want to carry! The vegan leather trim comes in seven color options. Add a monogram and a second, interchangeable strap to make this gift even more special.

3
DESIGNER DORM
Pottery Barn Kids Chris Loves Julia Turned Wood Pinboard
$199
POTTERY BARN KIDS
CREDIT: POTTERY BARN

From pictures of friends to note cards from class, your favorite college student will find no shortage of use for this decorative pinboard from Pottery Barn. Bonus: The turned wood frame lets them add a little designer touch to their dorm room.

4
SLEEP ESSENTIAL
Quince Mulberry Silk Beauty Sleep Mask
Now 60% Off
$50
$20
QUINCE.COM
CREDIT: QUINCE

If there's one thing every college kid loves, it's sleeping. This luxe eye mask from Quince will keep them comfortable and block light leaks, whether they're cramming in an afternoon nap before class or trying to sleep during their roommate's late-night gaming session.

5
TEAM PRIDE
Uncommon Goods Football Stadium Blueprints
$185
UNCOMMON GOODS
CREDIT: UNCOMMON GOODS

If your favorite student chose a school with a standout athletics program, chances are good they've got some serious team pride. With this unique art print from Uncommon Goods, they can pay tribute to their school's stadium. Choose from a selection of some of the most well-known institutions in the country, from UNC and Ohio State to the University of Michigan (Go Blue!).

6
SMELLS LIKE HOME
Homesick Connecticut Candle
$30
HOMESICK
CREDIT: HOMESICK

Even the most enthusiastic college students can experience a bout of homesickness now and then, whether they're 50 or 500 miles away. Give them a little taste of their childhood with a Homesick Candle scented to their state, like nutmeg and cinnamon to represent Connecticut, or Spanish moss and orange for Florida.

7
MEMORY KEEPER
Kodak PIXPRO FZ55 Digital Camera
$140
B&H PHOTO
CREDIT: KODAK

In case you haven't heard, the digital cameras of the early 2010s are back, and every college student wants one. This Kodak device will make it easy for them to snap memories at every football game and sorority meeting, thanks to a 28mm wide-angle lens and face detection technology.

8
MERCH MADNESS
Pottery Barn Teen College Tote Bag
$89
POTTERY BARN TEEN
CREDIT: POTTERY BARN TEEN

Nothing says stylish school pride quite like a tote you won't find in the campus merch store. With custom colorways, embroidered logos, and funky straps, this durable canvas tote will carry them from study sessions at the library to a trip to the gym (and everywhere in between).

9
WALK THIS WAY
Adidas Samba OG Shoes
$100
ADIDAS

College life makes it easy to get in 10,000 steps a day, whether that's trekking around a major city from class to class or walking back and forth around campus. Needless to say, a comfy pair of kicks is a must—and bonus points for ones that are stylish to boot. Adidas' classic Samba style is streamlined, gender neutral, and comes in a wide selection of colors. Choose their favorite shade or pick one that coordinates with the colors of their school.

10
PLUSH PERCH
Urban Outfitters Washed Corduroy Floor Pillow
Now 17% Off
$59
$49
URBAN OUTFITTERS

Dorm rooms are a bit like airport terminals; there's always someone coming and going. Ensure your favorite college student has a comfy way to entertain friends by snagging them a few of these plush floor pillows. They work great as bonus seating, but can also be used to make movie nights and study sessions more comfortable.

11
SNOOZE FEST
ThisWorks Deep Sleep Pillow Spray
$30
AMAZON
ALSO CONSIDER
$44
WALMART
CREDIT: NORDSTROM

Between late-night cramming for an upcoming test and nights out with friends, sleep is in short supply for most college students. Ensure they're making the most out of the zzzz's they do get with this pillow spray from ThisWorks. Made from a combination of ktktkt and tktktk, it'll promote relaxation and a restful night's sleep—even if they hit the hay at 2 a.m.

12
SNAP HAPPY
Canon Ivy 2 Mini Photo Printer
Now 15% Off
$120
$102
AMAZON
ALSO CONSIDER
$99
WALMART
$120
MACY'S
CREDIT: AMAZON

Ever try to scroll through a camera roll of 4,000 shots just to find the one you're looking for? Us too. Help your favorite college student take their memories from the Cloud to IRL with this handy photo printer from Canon. Bonus: It works with any device that has Bluetooth capabilities.

13
ORGANIZED CHAOS
Papier Academic Year Planner
Now 15% Off
$36
$31
PAPIER
CREDIT: PAPIER

Talk about a show stopper! College students live and breathe by their planners to keep all their assignments in order, and this is one design that they won't mind showing off. From the inspirational phrase on the front cover and chic colorways to the optional personalization, it's a statement maker even the most studious will appreciate.

14
GEN Z MUST-HAVE
Rhode The Glow Set
$65
RHODESKIN.COM
CREDIT: RHODE

Late-night studying and a less-than-balanced diet can leave even the most skincare-savvy college student with dull, dry skin. Help them combat it with a viral skincare favorites from Rhode. This trio of hits includes the brand's Glazing Milk, Glazing Mist, and Barrier Butter, all geared toward glowy hydration.

15
PEACE OF MIND
Birdie Personal Safety Alarm
$28
AMAZON
CREDIT: AMAZON

When you love someone, nothing is more important than keeping them safe. If your child recently went off to school and you've spent nights awake worrying about them, Birdie's personal safety alarm is here to ease your mind. Easily attached to their keychain, it'll sound a 130-decibel alarm when activated to alert others that they need help.

16
ADULTING 101
Nori Press Travel Steam Iron
$96
AMAZON
ALSO CONSIDER
$120
NORDSTROM
$120
TARGET
CREDIT: AMAZON

Sure, they're rolling out of bed and going to class in their sweats—but once interviews and internships roll around, they're going to need a way to be presentable. This handheld steamer and iron combo will make quick work of wrinkles to ensure they put their best foot forward during every academic venture to come.

17
WASH DAY
LoveShackFancy Essential Laundry Backpack
Now 33% Off
$59
$40
POTTERY BARN TEEN
CREDIT: POTTERY BARN TEEN

Chores, but make them chic! This backpack-style laundry bag will make it easy for them to haul their laundry to the dorm basement on the off chance they remember to do it. The front boasts a pocket for coins, detergent, or dryer sheets, and the pack can even be personalized with their name or monogram.

18
GRAB AND GO
lululemon Dual Pouch Wristlet
$48
LULULEMON
CREDIT: LULULEMON

Phone, wallet, keys—that's all pretty much any college student needs to head out the door. This Lululemon dual pouch wristlet will keep all that (and more) at the tip of their finger, so they can worry about more important stuff (like getting to class on time).

19
COOL TOUCH
Magic Chef Retro 3.2 cu. ft. 2-Door Mini Fridge
$249
HOME DEPOT
CREDIT: HOME DEPOT

Sometimes, a trip to the food hall is just too far. With this mini fridge from Magic Chef, they'll be able to keep their favorite snack and sips on hand for whenever hunger (or a late-night craving) strikes. The main body boasts plenty of room for things like yogurt and fruit, while the top freezer portion can probably house a few ice cream bars.

20
MIDNIGHT COMPANION
Glocusent Luz Lectura Recargable USB Reading Light
$13
AMAZON
ALSO CONSIDER
$13
WALMART
$21
GLOCUSENT.COM
CREDIT: AMAZON

Living with a roommate can be an adjustment, and there's a good chance that your favorite college student and their roomie don't have the exact same schedule. For those late nights when they need to stay up to study (or just finish their latest romance novel), this bookmark-style reading light offers the perfect amount of illumination.

ALYSSA LONGOBUCCO
Contributing Writer

 Alyssa Longobucco is a freelance writer, editor, and stylist with a background in interior and lifestyle content. Her work helps readers digest design trends and provides actionable expert advice for creating a home they love. She has over a decade of experience in the media industry, and her work has appeared in Real Simple, Good Housekeeping, SELF, Apartment Therapy, The Knot, Domino, HGTV Magazine, Country Living, and more. Alyssa holds a BA in Journalism and Public Relations from Marist College and interior design certifications from NYIAD and RIDQC.
